data_source: 2025 MLB real odds (The Odds API) + real boxscores (ESPN)

sgp_templates.name: same_player_hits_runs_3x
sgp_templates.description: Stack hits O0.5 + runs O0.5 for 3 batters in same game. Core edge: lift=1.441 on same-player hit→run correlation.

legs.player_criteria: batter with hits O0.5 and runs O0.5 both available
legs.correlation_role: hit puts player on base, drives run scoring

legs.player_criteria: SAME player as the hits leg
legs.correlation_role: run scoring correlated with being on base (lift=1.441)

sgp_templates.construction_rule: For each of 3 batters: add hits O0.5 OVER + runs O0.5 OVER. Pick batters with highest combined implied prob. All 6 legs must be in same game.
sgp_templates.correlation_edge_source: Same-player hits+runs lift=1.441 (P(both)=33.2% vs P(indep)=23.1%, n=30,023)

SAME player as the hits leg

sgp_templates.construction_rule: For each of 3 batters: add hits O0.5 OVER + rbis O0.5 OVER. Pick batters with highest combined implied prob.
sgp_templates.correlation_edge_source: Same-player hits+RBIs lift=1.517 (P(both)=27.5% vs P(indep)=18.2%, n=30,051)

sgp_templates.name: same_player_hits_runs_4x
sgp_templates.description: Stack hits O0.5 + runs O0.5 for 4 batters. Higher variance, massive payouts ($600+ per $10).
sgp_templates.construction_rule: For each of 4 batters: add hits O0.5 OVER + runs O0.5 OVER. Pick batters with highest combined implied prob.
sgp_templates.correlation_edge_source: Same-player hits+runs lift=1.441 amplified across 4 player sets

anti_patterns: Never stack only single-market props (all hits O0.5 without runs/rbis = negative ROI)
Never use pre-game total line as a filter (proven -11% to -40% ROI)
Never use number of heavy-favorite hitters as a filter (proven negative ROI)
Avoid total_bases props entirely (edge -19.7%, massively negative EV)
Never mix players from different games in same SGP slip

agent_consensus.line_value_hunter: All individual props are -EV; correlation exploitation is only path
agent_consensus.sgp_architect: Designed same-player multi-prop templates as primary vehicle
agent_consensus.correlation_exploiter: Books treat same-player props as quasi-independent, 44-52% mispricing
agent_consensus.risk_validator: Walk-forward validation: all 6 months positive ROI. 1,846 sample size.
agent_consensus.synthesis_director: Approved 3 templates with proven backtest results

reasoning: The core edge is SAME-PLAYER MULTI-PROP CORRELATION. Books price hits O0.5 and runs O0.5 for the same batter as quasi-independent, but the actual lift is 1.441x. A batter who gets a hit is ON BASE and 44% more likely to score a run than independence predicts. By stacking 3 players × 2 correlated props (hits + runs), we create 6-leg parlays at +1,661 average odds that hit 12.1% of the time (breakeven ~5.7%), generating +91.3% ROI. This edge is STRUCTURAL — it exists because books use simplified correlation models for SGP pricing that don't capture the causal chain: hit → on base → score run.
risk_notes: High variance inherent to +1,661 odds parlays. Expect losing streaks of 20-30 SGPs. Bankroll: $500 minimum, $10/SGP, max 5/day = $50 daily risk. Strategy requires books to continue underpricing same-player prop correlations. Edge may decay if books update SGP correlation models. NEVER increase stakes during losing streaks.
